title: Dedham Country and Polo Club

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Dedham Country and Polo Clubhouse can accommodate groups up to 150 guests. All events hosted at DCPC require member sponsorship. For further information inquire here. We are happy to make our Seth Raynor designed course available for golf outings. Your guests will enjoy beautiful vistas, challenging golf, delicious food and a professional staff that will cater to your needs. Private parties are available through member sponsorship or in consultation with Club management. From small business meetings to Fortune 500 outings to non-profit fundraisers, we are happy to support your event
